comment: QUESTS.md P4f, SPA-3 The Tenth. After the ending, with Spare and everything of his done but the ninth letter: Bram's bed asks and the answer is not yet; the courier on the Stair (Map 73) takes the ninth; the Safety Valve's bed is yes; Fitch's bed is an urging; Upper Clanging is empty of Cotterills and Bessie is at their door; Spare goes in and out of the party; the wayshrine's Rest is the birth; everybody is back with new pages, Cotter too; Spare rejoins from the step with his level and kit, and Big Brother; and a bed after that asks nothing.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._lines = []; }; window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s)); window._page = (n) => $gameMap.event(n).findProperPageIndex(); window._spare = () => $gameActors.actor(11); window._inParty = () => $gameParty._actors.includes(11);

steps.comment: The post-game, Spare with you at level 30 wearing Shim's washer, SPA-1, SPA-2 and SPA-4 done, everybody met (his gate needs it); no ninth letter yet.

steps.eval: $gameParty.gainGold(1000); $gameParty.addActor(11); const s = window._spare(); s.changeLevel(30, false); s.learnSkill(155); $gameParty.gainItem($dataArmors[27], 1); s.changeEquipById(5, 27); $gameSwitches.setValue(5, true); $gameSwitches.setValue(90, true); $gameSwitches.setValue(92, true); $gameSwitches.setValue(110, true); $gameSwitches.setValue(208, true); $gameSwitches.setValue(210, true); $gameSwitches.setValue(213, true); $gameVariables.setValue(1, 1); [[21,11],[21,12],[21,14],[21,15],[21,16],[21,17],[23,4],[23,5],[25,4],[22,9],[24,4],[61,12]].forEach(([m,e]) => $gameSelfSwitches.setValue([m,e,'A'], true)); $gameSelfSwitches.setValue([21,16,'B'], true); window._kit = s.equips().map(e => e ? e.id : 0); $gameMap.requestRefresh(); window._mark()

steps.label: Bram's house, Spare in the party with the bag and the washer

steps.comment: Bram's bed: sleep, and he asks. The trigger is not met, so not yet.

steps.check: [window._has('You wake up.'), window._has('Is it spring yet?'), window._has('You tell him not yet.'), $gameVariables.value(33), $gameSwitches.value(225)]
steps.label: the published waking, then the first ask, not yet

steps.comment: The Stair, Map 73: the courier on the landing, only with Spare and SPA-1 done.

steps.label: the courier is there
without SPA-1 done, nobody
walked to him on the landing

steps.check: [window._has('Dear Mam. Is it spring yet? Spare.'), window._has('entirely true'), $gameSwitches.value(224), window._page(13)]
steps.label: the ninth letter, posted; he has gone on down

steps.comment: The Safety Valve's bed: everything of Spare's is done now, so yes.

steps.check: [window._has('six o\'clock'), window._has('Then I have to go home.'), $gameSwitches.value(225), $gameVariables.value(33), $gameVariables.value(2) - window._tropes]
steps.label: Mr Kell's morning, then yes: spring, and the deadline's trope
Rivet is indoors for the day; Winnie is not a Cotterill

steps.comment: Fitch's cottage, the next night: an urging.

steps.check: [window._has('You can hear the sea.'), window._has('Mam will not wait.'), $gameVariables.value(33)]
steps.label: every waking from now is him hurrying you

steps.comment: Upper Clanging: every Cotterill is indoors, and Bessie is at their door.

steps.label: the doorstep is empty
Bessie at the Cotterills' door; Spare with you
facing her

steps.check: [window._has('Not before. Mam said.'), window._inParty(), $gameSwitches.value(90), $gameSwitches.value(226), window._page(22), window._page(13)]
steps.label: they go in; Spare is out of the party and off the step

steps.comment: A different bed for the night: the wayshrine on the world map. It is the birth, and nobody asks.

steps.check: [window._has('Nothing eats them.'), window._has('have come to be ten'), window._has('Is it'), $gameSwitches.value(225), $gameSwitches.value(226), $gameSwitches.value(227)]
steps.label: the birth, wherever the party is
Cotter's new page
everybody back out, Bessie home, Spare on the step
Mrs Cotterill: Washer, and then her short line
Clevis pays out

steps.comment: Spare, on the step: told, and then a choice. Not right now first: he stays on the step.

steps.eval: window._mark(); const sc = Game_Message.prototype.setChoices; Game_Message.prototype.setChoices = function (c, d, k) { Game_Message.prototype.setChoices = sc; return sc.call(this, c, 1, k); }; $gameMap.event(13).start()

steps.check: [window._has('I am a big brother.'), window._has('Then I will mind Washer.'), window._inParty(), $gameSwitches.value(228), window._page(13)]
steps.label: not right now: he minds Washer and stays on the step

steps.comment: Then come back with me: rejoins without initialise, at his level, in his kit, with Big Brother.

steps.check: [window._has('Can I come yet?') && window._has('rejoined the party'), window._inParty(), window._spare().level >= 30, window._spare().equips().map(e => e ? e.id : 0), window._spare().isLearnedSkill(195), window._spare().isLearnedSkill(155), $gameSwitches.value(90), $gameVariables.value(1) - window._comp, window._page(13)]
steps.label: back, nothing lost, one new skill, gone from the step

steps.check: (() => { const s = window._spare(); s.addState(45); const r = [s.isSubstitute(), s.pdr]; s.removeState(45); return r; })()
steps.label: Big Brother's state is the substitute flag

steps.comment: And a bed after that: the morning asks nothing any more.

steps.label: spring is over; nobody asks
